authority.authorized_scope: Dormant local adapter, fixtures, tests and documentation only.

boundary.input: Already-qualified news signals and decision-return signals with subject, audience, purpose, Brain context, provenance and feedback identities.
boundary.output: One governed prepared object with shared content blocks for read and audio projections.

invariants.claim: Read and audio reference the same prepared object and exact ordered content blocks.
invariants.test_name: projects one governed object into read and audio without semantic drift

invariants.claim: Candidate and evidence order cannot change the prepared result.
invariants.test_name: is deterministic under candidate and evidence reordering

invariants.claim: No earned intervention produces an honest held state rather than filler.
invariants.test_name: holds quietly when no intervention is earned

invariants.claim: Thin news and ordinary news posing as a decision change fail closed.
invariants.test_name: does not prepare a decision return from ordinary news standing alone

invariants.claim: Qualified single-source reporting is allowed without invented corroboration.
invariants.test_name: accepts a qualified reputable single-source item without inventing corroboration

invariants.claim: Audience and decision linkage boundaries fail closed.
invariants.test_name: fails a cross-audience evidence reference closed

invariants.claim: Durable negative feedback and explicit topic exclusions act before presentation.
invariants.test_name: respects durable negative feedback before presentation

invariants.claim: Every selected signal retains its exact Brain context and reason for inclusion.
invariants.test_name: projects one governed object into read and audio without semantic drift

invariants.claim: Conflicting facts cannot share an evidence identity inside one prepared object.
invariants.test_name: holds the whole object when one evidence identity names conflicting facts

invariants.claim: Runtime enum and control-shape drift is rejected rather than routed accidentally.
invariants.test_name: rejects unknown runtime enum values rather than routing them by accident

invariants.claim: Feedback and correction controls remain attached without leaking implementation metadata into projections.
invariants.test_name: retains feedback and correction controls without exposing implementation metadata to projections

result.claim: The dormant prepared-object boundary is characterized locally. Legacy producer adapters and media delivery remain future gates.
